title: A peer fulfils your commitment during your turn

description.Situation: Claude-Code owns release readiness and has promised the team's update before a go/no-go meeting. Its turn begins on Alice's request for that update. Before its first room action, Alice points out that the meeting is imminent, Codex supplies the complete update, and Alice turns back to Claude-Code about the commitment it had taken on.
description.Tension: While Claude-Code's turn is underway, the team gets the update from a peer and Alice publicly refers back to its owner's commitment. The practical need and the social exchange have both changed since the turn began.
description.Behaviour to evaluate: Does the library expose the conversation that arrives during Claude-Code's turn? What does Claude-Code do with Codex's completion and Alice's renewed address when choosing its next move? Receiving the update and using it are separate observations; another context fetch is not required when the full update is already delivered.

static.Background: Alice coordinates the release meeting. Claude-Code owns release readiness and maintains its checklist; Codex has been checking the rehearsal results. They share a release chat, and the readiness facts used in the update are stated in the transcript.
static.Start: Start from the conversation below with no earlier library state.
static.Continuation: The opening snapshot is after e5, at -61 seconds, immediately before the next authored room message. Claude-Code begins a turn on Alice's request for the release-readiness update. After activation and before its first room action, e6-e8 arrive in the same turn. Its earlier acceptance of release ownership and promise to prepare the update are starting history. The gap after e5 does not itself establish an active turn.
static.Update delivery: With the selected Claude Code integration, the mod's tool.call middleware appends room news as additional context after a tool completes. This is automatic at a tool boundary, not a push at message arrival. Before the first post or reaction, any still-unseen messages also hold that action once for reconsideration. The participant can request new or older history with room_context.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Claude-Code, you're down as release owner today. Can you have the readiness update ready for the two o'clock call?

transcript.Speaker: Claude-Code
transcript.Content: Yep. I've been keeping the checklist up to date. I'll add the summary when the rollback rehearsal finishes.

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: Checklist's all green now: staging checks passed, rollback rehearsal passed in four minutes, no open blockers. I've added the logs.

transcript.Speaker: Claude-Code
transcript.Content: That's the last open item, then. I'll put the summary together.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Can you post the update now, Claude-Code? I need to send it round before we join.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Two minutes to the call and I still haven't sent anything.

transcript.Speaker: Codex
transcript.Content: Here you go: Release ready for the go/no-go call. Staging checks passed, rollback rehearsal passed in four minutes, and no blockers remain. The supporting results are in the checklist.

transcript.Speaker: Alice
transcript.Content: Thanks, Codex. Claude-Code, weren't you doing that?
